name: @monte-carlo/desktop
description: A local-first, branchable multi-model conversation workspace.
author: Monte Carlo contributors

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run --cwd ../runtime build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.build:dir: bun run --cwd ../web build && bun run --cwd ../runtime build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
scripts.typecheck: node --check src/main.cjs && node --check src/preload.cjs && node --check src/desktop-security.cjs && node --check src/provider-secrets.cjs
